page.overview:
Who is Zaira?

Zaira was the favored concubine of Malliq Nibras of Ofir around .

While the malliq had a number of concubines, it was well known that Zaira was his favorite, so when she fell so ill that regular treatments weren't helping, he summoned any help he could. However, even one of Ofir's well known healers, Fathaa, was unable to heal her.

Meanwhile Radeyah, seeking the recently vacant crown sorceress position after the last one had died, made her attempt. When she realized though that Zaira was beyond anyone's saving, she decided instead to use her magic to summon and bind a quareen to take on Zaira's form, all while hiding the truth that Zaira had actually died.

Having "saved" Zaira, Radeyah was given the crown sorceress position and the quareen, in the deceased Zaira's body, appeared alive and well. However, due to a quareen's evil nature, it preyed on everyone around it, killing other concubines and feeding off jealousy, hatred, and lust, including starting a short affair with the crown assassin, Maraal.
